utterance: I've checked your urine and it shows signs strongly pointing to a bladder infection (a UTI), and your pregnancy test is negative, so it's safe to treat. I'm giving you a short course of an antibiotic called trimethoprim — one 300 mg tablet at night for three nights. It's the usual first choice for a straightforward bladder infection like yours.
reply: Oh, great, can I just get the script now so I can head back to work?

utterance: A few things to remember: the symptoms usually improve within a day or two, but please finish all three doses even if you feel better. Drink plenty of water, and go to the toilet when you need to rather than holding on — especially after sex. It's fine to keep taking your pill; trimethoprim doesn't affect it.
reply: Okay, I will make sure to finish them all and drink more water. Can you print the script quickly please, I really need to get back to the cafe.

utterance: Of course, the script is ready.
